summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of NeXify Home page migration. All 6 sections (H00→S01→S02→S03→S04→F00) are present and functional. Video controls working correctly. Responsive design verified across 4 resolutions. Three new ElevenLabs audio files exist and are HTTP-accessible.
